D: Three silent film stars mistake a real call for help from a Mexican village for a paid show.
P: Serve the mains at El Guapo's birthday party.
S: the cantina where they start a brawl
Corn chips layered with black beans and cheddar, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, topped with pico de gallo, pickled jalapeño, guacamole and sour cream.
the little village they ride in to save
Corn cobs grilled until charred, rolled in mayo and lime, covered in crumbled feta, chilli powder and coriander.
the singing bush in the desert
Green salsa: tomatillos and green chillies charred, blitzed with onion, garlic, coriander and lime, served with warm tortilla chips.
M: Pork shoulder marinated in achiote, orange and garlic, roasted wrapped at 160C for 4 hours, shredded, in corn tortillas with pickled red onion and habanero salsa.
Poached chicken rolled in corn tortillas, covered in red chilli sauce and cheese, baked at 190C for 20 minutes.
W: El Guapo's birthday cake, sort of
Choux dough piped into hot oil at 180C, fried golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar, with dulce de leche for dipping and a candle in the pile.
K: 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml lime shaken with ice, salt rim.

s.note: the little village they ride in to save
s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs until charred. Brush with 4 tbsp mayo mixed with lime juice. Roll in 100g crumbled feta and dust with chilli powder and chopped coriander.

s.note: the singing bush in the desert
s.how: Char 400g tomatillos and 2 green chillies under the grill. Blitz with half an onion, a garlic clove, coriander and lime juice until chunky. Serve with warm corn chips.

m.how: Marinate 1.2kg pork shoulder in 50g achiote paste, the juice of 2 oranges and 3 garlic cloves overnight. Wrap and roast at 160C for 4 hours, then shred. Quick-pickle a red onion in lime. Serve in 16 corn tortillas with habanero salsa.

w.note: El Guapo's birthday cake, sort of
w.how: Boil 250ml water with 60g butter, beat in 150g flour, then 2 eggs. Pipe into 180C oil and fry until golden. Toss in 100g sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon. Serve with dulce de leche for dipping and a candle in the pile.

d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml lime juice with ice. Strain into a glass with a salted rim. Makes four plethoras of margaritas.
